Quick answers to Marcus' questions (high level):
- Mostly single-turn requests for the first wave (~90% single-turn), but we expect a mix with multi-turn for chat workflows later. Avg step count today for multi-turn is ~4; 95th is ~12.
- Avg input length: 120 tokens; 95th: 640 tokens. Avg generated tokens per request: ~40.
- Yes, we will use streaming to clients for lower perceived latency.

I attached the CSV Samir mentioned with a minute-level snapshot and a short notes column describing traffic pattern by endpoint. We'd love to see Redwood's recommended GPU pool options and an initial cost/latency tradeoff view in the meeting.
